title: Nationality, Race, and Ethnicity Biases in and Consequences of Detecting AI-Generated Self-Presentations

bias_targets.methodology: Experimental manipulation of college applicants' names (using common names for White, Black, Hispanic, and Asian groups) and explicit racial/ethnic background information to measure how these cues affect human evaluators' likelihood of attributing the applicant's personal statement to AI.

Experimental manipulation of college applicants' nationality status (labeled implicitly and explicitly as Domestic vs. International students) to assess its impact on whether human evaluators suspect the use of AI in writing application materials.
